test_case.test_name: Ten loaded abrupt AC drops at 0C/-5% rails
test_case.purpose: Verify a fully populated system survives ten abrupt AC removals during established load and recovers data, devices and services under cold/low-rail margin.
required_package: Full inventory and safe storage workload map
test_case.test_command: Qualified staff establish dry 0C/-5% conditions, prove the approved five-minute load state before each event, execute ten controlled drops/reapplications and verify expected logs, data integrity, inventory and readiness after each.
test_case.expected_result: All ten events occur at the signed load state, record expected loss events, retain data/device integrity and restore services safely.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires ten distinct loaded abrupt drops with per-event evidence; graceful/unloaded cycles, unsafe writes, final boot only or retry cannot pass.
safety_gate: Abort on data/device, electrical, moisture, thermal or boot fault
Preserve logs; no auto-retry; dry warm-up
test_case.recovery: Stop on first disallowed result, preserve data/events, isolate power, restore nominal rails, warm/dry, recover or quarantine affected devices and do not repeat the failure.
